notes.title: A few things have changed, haven't they?
notes.content:
First things first:


The key assignment can now be found in the lower right corner of the screen and can be displayed with a single click.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560493/2d3c06da8e2af13163dc5381ee8f99f4b0180900.png"]


Furthermore:


..the existing maps in the game have been graphically redesigned and now have a uniform style.


New map:


The new map also brings new obstacles. Although it is quite short, it can take quite some time to reach the finish line.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560493/50777f54c919a1777bbfe15287c59b1ffdee0fa5.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560493/3764ae8d9e7ce33564b0548c505620c9798633c3.png"]

notes.title: Leveldesign Update and small changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The levels are gradually being updated and made more beautiful. So far level 01 has been redesigned and now also level 03.

Furthermore, the key assignment has been adjusted and the key assignment can be viewed via (keyboard) "C" or (gamepad) "directional pad up". (I'm still working on the design)
The arrow keys can now also be used to play on the keyboard.

Otherwise I was able to optimize the code a little bit.

Have fun playing! :)
